home.title: Coach's note
home.body: One career at a time. It saves itself after every pick and every match, so put it down whenever you like.

draft.title: Coach's note
draft.body: Ratings are hidden until kick-off. The cuttings are club-seasons: the question is which of these squads had the player you need.

squad.title: Coach's note
squad.body: Tap a row to see a player's sheet and swap him with someone else. Drag bench markers onto the board to bring them in.

board.title: Coach's note
board.body: The identity line says what kind of side your dials make. Pick a style to set every dial at once, then adjust the three under Approach.

season.title: Coach's note
season.body: One match at a time, and the board is read afresh before each. Play to… runs several off on the vidiprinter. Goals go to whoever your jobs and briefs put in front of goal.

window.title: Coach's note
window.body: Eight players, each from a real club-season, each with a price in wage points. Your finish last season set the budget. Replace shows on the board where he can play.

club.title: Coach's note
club.body: The record keeps every season. Your career code lets anyone start the same draft.
